title: Rare vault finds are remembered
summary: The rarest rewards in vaults are now counted across every passenger. Pull one that nobody has ever pulled before and you will be told you are the first. Rare finds from the tougher vaults also carry their number, who pulled them and the date.
highlights: Be the first passenger ever to pull a rare vault reward and you will hear about it
Rare finds from the tougher vaults show which number they are, who pulled them and when
